safety.text: A 29-year sheriff's deputy, Alanis emphasizes cracking down on drug dealers and holding criminals accountable.
safety.quote: He is leading efforts to crack down on fentanyl dealers, prevent smash-and-grab robberies, and fix laws that fail to hold criminals accountable.

energy.text: Alanis is working to suspend California's gas tax to lower the state's high gas prices.
energy.quote: Juan is working to fix California's highest-in-the-nation gas prices by working to suspend the gas tax
